newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank gets nod for Filipino bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Maybank gets nod for Filipino bank stake.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank), Malaysia's largest banking group, has received approval from the board of directors of Philippine National Bank (PNB) to buy 60 percent of PNB-Republic Bank.
Maybank said in a statement late on Friday that PNB had approved in principle the sale of its stake in PNB-Republic Bank for 880 million pesos.
PNB-Republic Bank is a 58.8 percent-owned commercial banking subsidiary of PNB.
"Maybank shall immediately proceed with the negotiations with PNB to resolve the qualifications included in the bid submitted by Maybank," the Maybank statement said.
It said the decision on the issuance of the notice of award will be made not later than January 31.
PNB had set the floor price for the stake in PNB-Republic Bank at 800 million pesos.
